title: XTTS Local Settings
description: XTTS Local is the built-in voice engine. It uses your Studio voice profiles for verification, and it needs the Studio XTTS environment plus the Python packages listed in its requirements before it can be enabled.

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: How fast the voice speaks. Use a value below 1.0 for slower, more deliberate speech. Use a value above 1.0 for faster speech.

temperature.title: Temperature
temperature.description: How adventurous the model is when choosing the next sound. Lower values are steadier and more predictable. Higher values add variation, but can also make output less consistent.

repetition_penalty.title: Repetition Penalty
repetition_penalty.description: Helps the model avoid repeating the same words or sounds. Raise it if the voice loops or gets stuck repeating itself.

top_k.title: Top-K
top_k.description: Limits each choice to the top K most likely options. Smaller values are stricter and steadier. Larger values allow more variation.

top_p.title: Top-P
top_p.description: Controls how wide the model can search for the next sound. A good starting point is around 0.9. Lower values keep the voice tighter and more predictable; higher values make it more varied, but can also make it wander.

safe_mode.title: Safe Mode
safe_mode.description: Use a more conservative cleanup path before synthesis. Leave this on if XTTS is unstable or if you want the safest default behavior.

model.title: Model
model.description: XTTS model version to use for synthesis.

max_chars_per_second.title: Max Plausible Speech Rate (chars/sec)
max_chars_per_second.description: Output QA cap: if rendered audio implies a speech rate faster than this (characters divided by duration), it is flagged as likely truncated and rejected. Normal speech is ~12-15 chars/sec; the default 60 only catches clearly broken output. Set to 0 to disable.

keep_model_loaded.title: Keep Model Loaded
keep_model_loaded.description: When enabled, XTTS keeps the voice model loaded in a background process between renders instead of reloading it each time. This saves roughly 19 seconds per render group but uses more memory while the model is warm. Disable this on machines where memory is limited.

keep_model_loaded_idle_seconds.title: Model Idle Timeout (seconds)
keep_model_loaded_idle_seconds.description: How long to keep the model loaded after the last render before releasing it. Set to 0 to disable the timeout entirely (the model stays loaded until Studio restarts or Keep Model Loaded is turned off). Requires Keep Model Loaded to be enabled.

computer_speed_multiplier.title: Computer Speed
computer_speed_multiplier.description: Computed from completed renders for this plugin and shown in characters per second. This calibrates Studio's render-time estimates and does not change voice speaking speed.

x-ui.summary: XTTS Local stays on your machine, but it still needs the Studio XTTS runtime and any Python packages listed by the engine before it can be turned on. Good starting values are speed 1.0, temperature around 0.7, top-p around 0.9, top-k around 40 to 50, and a repetition penalty around 1.1 to 1.2. If the card says needs setup, click Install Deps to install the required packages, then verify the engine again using the Default Voice from General settings.
